description: GraphRAG golden retrieval set. Queries are paraphrased and often mention a tool/concept without copying the fixture title, so they test whether the graph (shared tool/concept/claim) plus claim authority can surface the right note when flat vector recall is noisy. Fixtures are the same files used by data/eval/golden.json; fixture ids resolve to wiki-NNNN ids at ingest time.

queries.query: BuildKit keeps rebuilding the dependency layer even when package-lock did not change
queries.rationale: Requires 'docker'/'buildkit' tool link or 'layer caching' concept link; title/body phrasing differs from the query.

queries.query: Postgres rejects new connections during a traffic spike despite the app seeming fine
queries.rationale: Connects via 'postgres'/'pgbouncer' tools and 'connection pooling' concept; query does not name deadpool.

queries.query: JVM pod restarts because the kernel killed the process for memory
queries.rationale: Graph link through 'kubernetes'/'jvm' tools and 'oom killer' concept; query avoids 'OOMKilled' verbatim.

queries.query: Typing in a search box makes every row in a React list render again
queries.rationale: Links via 'react' tool and 'memoization' concept; query does not use 'useCallback' or 'React.memo'.

queries.query: Users get logged out because the server thinks their token is from the future
queries.rationale: Concept/time-axis signal; relies on claim/temporal authority as much as vector similarity.

queries.query: Docker image build reinstalls npm packages on every source edit
queries.rationale: Same topic as query 1 but with different wording; tests graph stability across paraphrases.

queries.query: Database connection count grows without bound until Postgres says too many clients
queries.rationale: Paraphrase of query 2; shared tool/concept lane should still surface the note.

queries.query: Container memory limit is smaller than the JVM heap plus off-heap allocations
queries.rationale: Paraphrase of query 3; tests concept-link consistency.

queries.query: List component re-renders all children because the parent passes a new inline function each time
queries.rationale: Paraphrase of query 4; 'referential stability' concept link should help.

queries.query: Authentication token is rejected due to clock difference between issuer and verifier
queries.rationale: Paraphrase of query 5; temporal claim authority should beat old chunk noise.
